issues.claim: South Amboy Car Wash & Detailing Center, 2087 Route 35, phone (732) 952-2462
issues.problem: Phone digit transposition: the city directory row for the car wash at 2087 RT. 35 gives (732) 952-2642, and a search-result listing repeats 952-2642. The list's 952-2462 did not appear in any source I saw.
issues.fix: Change phone to (732) 952-2642 (or mark Unknown); keep the note that the site was formerly branded Go Go Car Wash.

issues.claim: Harbor Air, LLC is a South Amboy business at 1122 Cook Ave
issues.problem: 1122 Cook Ave is in Laurence Harbor, which is part of Old Bridge Township, not South Amboy (the 08879 zip overlaps). The company also has its own site (hvacharbor.com) and phone 732-589-4353, neither recorded; the town name is only right if the zone's radius rule is applied.
issues.fix: Town should read 'Laurence Harbor (Old Bridge Twp)', note 'in radius, outside South Amboy', and backfill website hvacharbor.com and phone 732-589-4353.

issues.claim: Odyssey Mixed Martial Arts, 200 John T. O'Leary Blvd
issues.problem: The gym's own contact page says 'Visit Us: South Amboy YMCA, 200 John T. O'Leary Blvd' - the address is the YMCA building, and the mapper excluded the South Amboy YMCA itself as a network branch. It is a class programme renting YMCA space, not independent premises. The site also publishes (732) 298-2839, which the list records as Unknown.
issues.fix: Keep only with a note that it operates inside the South Amboy YMCA, and fill in phone (732) 298-2839.

issues.claim: Clyde Auto Recycling is in South Amboy at 6000 Main Street
issues.problem: 6000 Main St sits in the Parlin/Sayreville stretch; a NJ Department of Health scrap-metal facility report for Sayreville borough lists Clyde Auto Recycling at 6000 Main St. The South Amboy label appears to come from the 08879 zip.
issues.fix: Re-label town as Sayreville/Parlin (in radius) or drop; verify municipality before outreach.

issues.claim: John P. Morro, CPA, PA - active South Amboy practice, address Unknown
issues.problem: Only evidence is one CPA directory listing, with no address or phone. A legacy.com obituary for a John Morro, Jr. of New Jersey dated 29 Aug 2025 turned up in search; I could not tie it to this CPA (that obituary appears to be for a 'Heights' resident), so the practice may be inactive or the listing stale.
issues.fix: Verify the practice is still operating (NJ CPA licence lookup or a call) before keeping; otherwise drop the row.

issues.claim: Joseph J. Madura, DDS (Alkham Dental) at 360 Main Street
issues.problem: The dentist is real and his own site (josephjmaduradmd.com) gives 360 Main St and 732-721-1166, but Delta Dental and other current listings now show 'Clear Path Dentistry' at the same address and phone, while the list names the practice Alkham Dental after a different insurer directory. Which brand is current is unresolved.
issues.fix: Note that the practice trades as Clear Path Dentistry in at least one current payer directory; confirm the current trading name.

issues.claim: Thomas E. Downes, PA at 101 N Feltus St, (732) 679-5000
issues.problem: City directory matches the entry, but a YellowPages attorney listing shows 'Thomas E. Downs, PA' at 415 Main St with (732) 679-5600. One of the two address/phone pairs is stale.
issues.fix: Confirm the office address and number before outreach; add a note about the conflicting listing.

issues.claim: Little People's Day School at 257 4th Street
issues.problem: The city directory lists a different business (Sweet Art Cakes LLC) at 257 Fourth Street, so the day school's address rests on a YellowPages row plus state childcare data that I did not see matched to this street number.
issues.fix: Verify the street address (and that it is operating) before outreach; if unconfirmed, drop.

issues.claim: Coverage of HVAC contractors in town
issues.problem: General Mechanical Services of NJ, LLC at 413 Raritan St, South Amboy, 732-558-3190 (site gmsofnj.com) appears in the mapper's own BestProsInTown HVAC source but is not in the list.
issues.fix: Add General Mechanical Services of NJ, LLC (413 Raritan St, 732-558-3190, gmsofnj.com).

issues.problem: Three in-town firms found on lawyers.com / YellowPages / Super Lawyers are absent: CourtLaw (1945 NJ-35), Gregory F. Kusic (301 Main St, 732-721-1688) and the Law Offices of Gary S. Forshner (South Amboy).
issues.fix: Add CourtLaw and Gregory F. Kusic; add Forshner only if an office address can be confirmed.

issues.problem: B & M Automotive LLC, 253 Kath St, South Amboy, (732) 721-0886, 4.8 stars from 70 reviews, is not in the list although it is a stronger listing than several bulk-directory rows that are.

Liberty Landscapes, Pavers and Maintenance LLC, (732) 583-6622, appears with a South Amboy 08879 area on Porch and in YellowPages, but D&B places the business in Old Bridge Township - a candidate, not a certain in-town miss.
issues.fix: Check the base address; add if the shop or yard is in town or inside the radius under the mapper's rule.

issues.claim: Excluded-type boundaries: Vrola / Primal Custom Cutting / Tidal Seafood, Super Meat Products, Cambridge Pavers
issues.problem: The two meat/seafood operations are processors and wholesalers, i.e. 'food' businesses under a literal reading of the exclusion, even though they are not restaurants or delivery kitchens. Cambridge Pavers is a large multi-plant hardscape manufacturer entered via its South Amboy yard and its main line (201-933-5000), which reads more like a network brand than a local independent.
issues.fix: State explicitly in the list why processors/wholesalers and the Cambridge yard count as eligible B2B manufacturing targets; otherwise drop them.

issues.claim: Excluded-type boundaries: childcare/preschool and school-named entries
issues.problem: Three childcare/preschool entries (Children's Center for Learning, Creative Kids Daycare, Little People's Day School) and two 'school' businesses (South Amboy Arts, EZ Wheels Driving School) sit near the 'schools' exclusion. South Amboy Arts is additionally the city's Arts Alliance gallery per the city website, which touches the government/non-profit line.
issues.fix: Add a one-line rule note that licensed private childcare, arts and driving schools count as businesses (not the excluded K-12/college institutions), or remove them.

issues.claim: Remaining single-source entries and blank fields
issues.problem: Roughly half the list rests on one directory row each (city directory, loc8nearme, bestprosintown, Angi) and several have no phone or no street number. Most of the ones I checked held up (Kiki Pools, Drainpro, AVC Tax, Lionheart, A&K Air, Eastern Orthodontics, Amboy Motel confirmed), but A&K Air, Amboy Motel, Titan MMA and Dynamic Realty Group all have phones or sites published elsewhere that the list leaves blank.
issues.fix: Backfill known phones/sites (A&K 908-247-1192, Amboy Motel 732-721-1525, Titan MMA 732-707-3325, Dynamic Realty Group drgusa.com) and keep the confirm-before-outreach caveat.
